verdict.rationale: Cekura documents an official SDK with sync and async clients for application code, and a LiveKit tracing integration built on the Cekura SDK, so official SDK-based instrumentation exists. The evidence does not state which languages the SDK supports, and nothing shows a JS/TS SDK; the npx command installs AI-assistant skills, not an instrumentation SDK. missing for 10: explicit confirmation of an official Python SDK, any evidence of an official JS/TS SDK, general app-tracing docs beyond LiveKit, independent corroboration.
